correctness.rationale: The shift condition x_i in {x_{i+1},x_{i+3},x_{i+4}} forbids exactly 01011,01111,10000,10100 as length-five blocks. The overlap matrix of all sixteen four-block states has 28 edges and produces a bijection between cyclic words and closed walks, P_n=trace(M^n). Fresh independent exact SymPy determinant agrees with lambda^4(lambda-1)^3(lambda+1)(lambda^2-lambda-1)(lambda^2+lambda+1)(lambda^4+lambda^2-1); determinant identity gives the claimed rational Artin-Mazur zeta at all lengths, not just checked periods. Four strongly connected classes include one primitive twelve-state core, whose Perron root is phi; other classes have spectral radius one, establishing entropy log phi and a unique maximal-entropy measure. Complement symmetry forces binary marginal 1/2. Fresh brute enumeration of all cyclic binary words at n=1..12 agreed with the traces, and graph strongly connected partition was checked independently. Scope is two-sided binary sequences for this exact triple only.
